company.name: Sendblue
company.shortDescription: SendBlue provides iMessage solutions for businesses
company.description: Sendblue is a business messaging platform that helps companies send and receive iMessage, SMS, and RCS from their CRM, workflows, AI agents, and custom applications. Its REST API and integrations let sales, support, ecommerce, healthcare, and developer teams add native blue-bubble iMessage conversations to tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, Zendesk, Intercom, Zapier, Make, and custom software.

productsAndServices.description: An API that enables businesses to send marketing and communication messages via iMessage, simplifying text-based outreach.
productsAndServices.name: iMessage API
